description: Frederik Hendrikbuurt 1885-1890 four-storey front, the plain sister of fh-1887-dentil-pediment: the rows alternate a dentil pair, a plain pand, a gable pand (Houweningenstraat, Van Reigersbergenstraat, Frederik Hendrikstraat 134-154). Red-brown brick, 3 axes on ~4.7 m, tall two-light windows with white frames under flat brick heads (no stone dressing, no white bands), dark iron wall anchors on the piers, white cornice with consoles, one white pediment dormer, ground storey with a pair of red doors beside a wide window.

match.note: houweningen-1-31, houweningen-2-38, reigersbergen-1-37, hendrik-134-154 strips (2021-2022); 3DBAG eaves 13.5-14.0 m

pediment-dormer.note: houweningen-1-31 and hendrik-134-154: one white pediment dormer with a finial over the centre of nearly every pand; dormerBody timber (painted white, as the clercq types): with stone the dormer glass had no host wall (houweningen-2-38-r1 opening-outside, 4 dormers, 4.4 m2)

roof.evidence: strips 2021-03/2022-04: over the cornice only the dormers and gables stand against the sky; dark slate band behind (hendrik-134-154)

rhythm.windowsPerStorey: ground: pair of doors + wide window | 1: 3 | 2: 3 | 3: 3
rhythm.roofline: white cornice, centre pediment dormer, occasional pointed gable
rhythm.signage: none above the ground; per-door numbers
rhythm.identicalBays: upper storeys: equal axes, no balconies

evidence.citation: read off the 2021-02-22 strip: flat brick heads, anchors, no white bands

door-left.note: a pair of red doors under one transom on the left axis beside a wide two-light casement; mirrored when the strip reads it on the right
